description: All-in-one full-stack development environment manager (Apache/Nginx/Caddy/PHP/MySQL/MariaDB/PostgreSQL/MongoDB/Redis/Node/Python/Go/Java/Ollama etc.), the open-source alternative to XAMPP/phpStudy.
notes: FlyEnv is an all-in-one local dev environment manager (successor of PhpWebStudy).

Service/module data lives in FlyEnv-Data, persisted at persist\flyenv\FlyEnv-Data; the installer sets machine env var FLYENV_DATA_ROOT to it (FlyEnv's official data-root override), so data survives Scoop updates and uninstall.
App settings stay in %APPDATA%\FlyEnv (Electron userData) and are unaffected by Scoop updates.

script: if ($payload) { Expand-7zipArchive "$($payload.FullName)" "$dir" -Removal } else { throw 'FlyEnv NSIS payload app-*.7z not found' }
